run_SHASSegmentAudioModule: run the SHASSegmentAudioModule to segment audio files into speech segments using the SHAS model
create_SHASSegmentAudioConfig: create a SHASSegmentAudioConfig dataclass to configure language, shards, model path, and inference parameters
load_model_SHAS: load a pretrained SHAS model checkpoint for audio segmentation using the provided config
segment_file_audio: segment an audio file into speech segments and yield start, end timestamps with batch numbers
review_SHASSegmentAudioModule_run: review the SHASSegmentAudioModule run method that processes audio shards and writes segment boundaries to output
